segments.text: A second-year student at Suimei Academy.

He is withdrawn and not interested in the 3D world and its inhabitants. He avoids conversations with others whenever possible and only attends school in order to fulfill the minimum attendance requirement for graduation. His interests lie in watching anime, playing eroge, and Empire Sweeper Online, an MMORPG where he's the top player "Neidhardt".
He suffers from intense delusions as a result of his apparent schizophrenia and the extremely secluded lifestyle he lives as a shut-in.
Edited from Wikipedia
「私立翠明学園」二年生で本作の主人公。
人との直接的なコミュニケーションを極端に嫌い、
最低限の外出しかしない引きこもり。
しかし、本人は引きこもりであることを否定している。
妄想癖が激しく、辛い現実から逃避しては自分に都合のいい「妄想」をして、
逃げ出した事実を他人に責任転嫁する、いわゆるダメ人間。

本編の主人公。私立翠明学園2年生。人との直接的なコミュニケーションを嫌い、最低限の外出しかしないネット依存症の少年。ナイトハルトというハンドルネームで1日中ネットゲームをし、学校は出席日数を計算して必要以上に登校しない。人と話せばどもってしまい、それが女の子ならばパニックを起こすほど。周囲からは引きこもりと思われているが、本人はそれを否定する。妄想癖があり思いこみが激しく、しばしばネガティブな方向へ暴走する。また、辛い現実から逃避し、ひたすら自分に都合のいい妄想をしてそれに浸っている。辛い現実に直面するとすぐに逃げ出してしまい、しかもそれを他人に責任転嫁する。いわゆるダメ人間。
A mysterious pink-haired girl that claims to be Takumi's classmate and friend.
Takumi, however, has no memory of her, and the circumstances in which he meets her make it even harder for him to trust her.
Edited from Wikipedia
主人公・拓巳の前に現れた謎の少女。
拓巳が通う「私立翠明学園」の制服を着ていて、
彼に対し、優しく気さくな笑顔を向けてくる。
だが、彼女の真意や目的は一切不明。
今作のメインヒロイン。拓巳がニュージェネ第三の事件（張り付け事件）の現場で出会った謎の少女。屈託ない明るさを持つ行動派で口癖は「ビシィッ!」。
Takumi's younger sister and a first-year at Suimei Academy.
She often puts up a strong front and argues with her brother whenever they meet but she is actually really concerned about him.
Edited from Wikipedia
「私立翠明学園」の一年生で、拓巳の妹。
強気で活発で口が悪く、拓巳に対しても生意気。
だが内心では、一人暮らしをする兄を心配している。
ヒロインの一人。拓巳の実妹。翠明学園の1年生で、実家から通学している。一人称は「ナナ」。兄である拓巳の事を「おにぃ」と呼び、少々ブラザーコンプレックス気味。
A second-year Suimei Academy student by day and a vocalist by night.

She sings under the stage name "FES" for a popular indie rock band named "Phantasm". The lyrics in her songs appear to describe the events of the recent murders in Shibuya, leading the police to see her as a potential suspect. She is also the most spiritual and eccentric of the main characters.
Chaos;Head Noah:

It is revealed that Ayase doesn't see the world the same way as other people, probably since she became a Gigalomaniac. She always sees a world with a red sky full of people with malice and negative delusions, and the reason why Ayase was able to know immediately that Takumi was a Gigalomaniac like her the first time she sees him, is most likely also because of that.
From Wikipedia
「私立翠明学園」二年生で、
人気バンド「ファンタズム」のボーカル。
淡々とした口調で、大人っぽく見られがちだが、
ぞの実アンニュイで無気力、感受性が高く、言動はかなり電波系。
ヒロインの一人。翠明学園の2年生で、拓巳とは違うクラス。人気バンド「ファンタズム」のボーカル「FES」として音楽活動もしている。長身で寡黙、神秘的で妖艶さをも持ち合わせる美少女だが、発言の殆どが電波で一般人には理解不能な事ばかりするためコミュニケーションが取れる人物は極めて少ない。
A third-year student at Suimei Academy.
Takumi initially believes her to be a stalker but quickly befriends her after discovering that she's a fellow otaku.
Chaos;Head Noah Spoilers:

In Chaos;Head Noah, it is revealed that she's in fact Mia and the one that really died was Yua. Afterwards, Mia started suffering from real DID, believing that she was Yua while unconsciously blaming herself as the one that should have died instead of her twin sister.
From Wikipedia
「私立翠明学園」三年生。
誰にでも優しく、年下にも敬語で話す少女。
少し気の弱い面があるが、我慢強い所もあり、
一度決めたことは、最後までやり遂げようとする。
ヒロインの一人。翠明学園3年生。誰に対しても敬語を使う心優しい眼鏡っ娘。普段は少し気弱でも一度決めた事はとことんやり遂げようとする性格。だが豹変すると冷徹かつ威圧的な口調と化して乱暴な手段を取るようになる。
A third-year student at Suimei Academy.
Takumi first encounters her at school but quickly excuses himself after facing her ominous glare. She is often seen standing around Shibuya holding a very long sword and eating a light blue ice pop.
Edited from Wikipedia
「私立翠明学園」の三年生。
クールで人を寄せ付けない性格で、
誰彼かまわず睨みつけるため、いつも一人でいて、クラスでは浮いた存在。
学校にもほとんど来ず、毎日のように渋谷を徘徊しているらしい。
ヒロインの一人。翠明学園3年生。好きな教科は科学で幅広い理系の知識を持っている。男勝りで強気の性格をしているのだが、実際にはその凛々しい姿からは想像出来ないほど気が弱くてヘタレであり、それを周囲に悟らせない為に強気の態度で隠しているに過ぎない。子犬が苦手。拓巳からは梢と並んで「貧乳姉妹」と称された。
A second-year student that transfers into Suimei Academy early on in the story.
She is not shown to be speaking but appears to have telepathic abilities. She calls herself Kozu-pii.
Chaos;Head Love Chu Chu:

It's confirmed that after the true ending of the original game, Kozue was able to overcome her mental trauma and now she's able to talk normally if she wants to, although sometimes she still continues talking telepathically.
「私立翠明学園」の二年生。
おとなしい性格でいつもオドオドしている女の子。
ドジっ娘で泣き虫、とにかくすぐに謝るクセがある。
そのため、異性の受けはいいが、同性からはよく思われていない様子。
ヒロインの一人。翠明学園2年生。物語の途中で拓巳のクラスに転校してくる。見た目の愛らしさから異性の評判は良いが、同性（主に三住に好意を持つ女子達）からは評判が悪い。一人称及び愛称は「こずぴぃ」。語尾は「-なのら」。
Yua's twin sister that died in the Group Diving case. Mia was the polar opposite of Mia, being an extremely poor student, and an outright delinquent. This caused pretty strong favoritism towards Yua.
Chaos;Head Noah Spoilers:
In Chaos;Head Noah, it is revealed that Yua is in fact the one that really died, not Mia, and the Yua in the main story is really Mia deluding herself into believing she is Yua.

The main heroine of "Blood Tune: The Animation" and also Takumi's favorite anime character. She is also the older sister of the character Erin-Fray Orgel, another extremely popular heroine from "Blood Tune".
Edited from Wikipedia

Takumi's online friend, who talks to him almost everyday through their mutual favorite online game. He often encourages Takumi to have more courage while dealing with the "third dimension", and supports him throughout his many ordeals. He is very interested in the New Generation incidents and frequently updates Takumi with gory details regarding the murders. As his interests in anime, manga, and games are very similar to Takumi's, the two get along very well.
It is revealed later that Grimm is a she, as well as one of the New Generation culprits.
Edited from Wikipedia

Shogun is a mysterious person that Takumi meets during a chatting session. He sends gore pictures relating to the New Generation incident to Takumi, the equation "fun^10xint^40=Ir2", and the phrase "Whose eyes are those eyes?", which Takumi often used. This event gives Takumi paranoia throughout the story, thinking that Shogun is spying on him and trying to kill him.
From Wikipedia
Takumi's only friend in class. Unlike Takumi, he's assertive and a womanizer.
Edited from Wikipedia
A detective for the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department Criminal Investigation Division.
He's investigating the New Generation murders along with his partner Suwa. He's friends with Momose.
Edited from Wikipedia

A detective for the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department Criminal Investigation Division. He is Ban's junior, and Ban considers him to be both an underling and a friend. His hobby is watching movies, especially Spark Wars.
He is the other perpetrator of New Generation murders along with "Grimm".
Edited from Wikipedia
President of "Trustworthiness Investigation Company Freesia."
Chaos;Child:
She is Kunosato's legal guardian, and also Serika's in the true ending.
Chaos;Head Noah:

She is a Debugger working for or with the Committee of 300, informing them from the shadows about anything that might help or serve as an obstacle, all to fulfill their ambition of bringing order to the world.
A nurse that assists Takumi's doctor.
She is Grimm and also the serial killer behind most of the New-Gen cases.
She will be wearing glasses if Takumi decides that he prefers glasses girls while talking to Grimm at the start of the story.
She is a member of the cult detective Ban is investigating, known as the "Cosmic Church of the Divine Light". She kills herself by driving a stake used in the third New-Gen case into her throat.
Edited from Wikipedia
Takumi's childhood doctor.
He works at AH Tokyo General Hospital.
He is the president of Nozomi Technology.
Chaos;Head:

Previously to his current occupation he was a former doctor and at some point he awakened as a Gigalomaniac. As such, he has lived about double the years as a Gigalomaniac than the other characters. With a strong disgust and hate of the world, for the purpose of fullfing his utopia he didn't hesitate to torture and sacrifice other people for the greater good. While he bacame one of the pawns of the Committee of 300, his true purpose was to create Noah II in order to revolt against the Committee of 300 and use Noah II as a God that would grant true happiness to mankind.
